title: Day 139: US Expands Strikes Into Northern Iran, Disables Blockade-Runner; Iranian Missiles Hit 2 UAE Tankers in Omani Waters
detail: US forces expanded strikes into northern Iran and disabled a vessel attempting to run the naval blockade. Iran's military said it struck and disabled two 'rogue supertankers,' hours after the UAE said Iranian missiles hit two of its tankers in Omani territorial waters. Washington's public terms to end hostilities: Iran must declare all Hormuz channels open toll-free, halt attacks on shipping, and hand over its highly-enriched uranium stockpile.

media.caption: US expands strikes into northern Iran as UAE tankers hit in Omani waters
